detail.longDescription: 📢 Rackspace Spot breach exposed Kubernetes secrets in customer clusters Rackspace told customers that an intruder with leaked credentials could read Secrets, create pods and list nodes in affected Spot clusters, and an extended console outage slowed the clean-up. 🔗 https:// securityelites.com/news/racksp ace-spot-breach-kubernetes-secrets-exposed/ # databreaches # kubernetes # kubernetessecrets
